verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal documents an expense API (retrieval and update endpoints, request parameters, pagination, field selection) and an MCP server. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, a 'try it' console, or runnable examples. Static endpoint documentation and MCP setup snippets are adjacent features and do not meet the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
